description:
A string representing a valid internationalized e-mail address.

## Definition

`https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-data-types/def/data-type/string-idn-email` is a `dt:DataType` in the `dt:dataTypes` concept system. It names a kind of data, not its encoding.

## Usage

An Implementation Profile can express this type as:

```json
{ "type": "string", "format": "idn-email" }
```

Valid values: `jörg@example.org`.

Same as String — email, but the address may contain non-ASCII characters.

As with any JSON Schema `format`, whether a value is actually checked depends on the validator.
